title: Threefold Reliquary
description: Corbelled white limestone ribs surround a levitating violet seed and its free-standing energy filaments.

review.notes: Round 2. Fixed: core is now a faceted violet crystal instead of a white-glowing egg; ribs are tapered horn shapes of different heights with joints and a weathered band only at the base; plinth with ring steps is a clear improvement. Not fixed: (1) the core is a coarse flat-shaded lozenge with blocky light rectangles on two faces that look painted on; model proper facets/inner bands and give it a restrained inner glow from the core outwards. (2) The four filaments are flat ribbon strips (paper/plastic look) floating loosely beside the core, and one passes in front of it in the close-up; make them thin, tapered energy strands with bright narrow cores that clearly orbit or emerge from the core. (3) The thin strands from the core to the floor end in a flat purple disc in the step hole; give them a proper emitter (socket, crystal seat) at the floor. (4) Ribs still have very even block joints and no chips; add 1-2 broken/chipped rib blocks and vary block lengths.
